auditMetadata.auditor: Principal Systems Architect / UDX Production Activation

subsystemInventory.details: Domain-neutral 9-primitive architecture (person, intent, state, world, possibility, path, action, outcome, memory). 61/61 files pass domain independence acid test with zero career leaks.
Distills unstructured user signals into canonical intents. Dynamic intent collapse. Handles multi-dialect Hinglish, leet-speak, colloquialisms.
CurrentStateModel separates live database supply (456 active jobs in Supabase) from verified partner supply (16 Varanasi roles) with explicit epistemic statuses.
Honesty Gate enforces zero false certainty. Rejects impossible economic, spatial, temporal, physical paradoxes with NO_RELIABLE_PATH.
Computes best path across possibilities using multi-dimensional utility scoring and historical memory weights.
Explicit state transitions: ACTION_PROPOSED -> ACTION_DISPATCHED -> ACTION_ACCEPTED -> ACTION_COMPLETED -> ACTION_FAILED. Tracks authentic downstream latencies.
Maturity progression: ACTION_COMPLETED -> OUTCOME_PENDING -> OUTCOME_OBSERVED -> OUTCOME_VERIFIED. Enforces ACTION_COMPLETED precondition; dynamic metrics only.
Commits verified outcome feedback to Supabase udx_search_memory and udx_audit_log. Confirmed +2.0% dynamic lift and -14.0% failure penalty.
Directly bound to live canonical intents (worldPayload.canonicalIntents). Static sampleIntents purged. Honest empty state: TELEMETRY_INGESTING / NO_VERIFIED_DATA.
Edge handlers for POST /api/udx/resolve, /api/udx/action, /api/udx/outcome. Keeps TALENTXCEL_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY strictly server-side.
Stores 2,311 demand entities, 2,311 opportunities, 456 active jobs, 16 verified Varanasi jobs, immutable audit log and search memory tables.
Connector implementation exists; 2,311 demand entities successfully seeded in Supabase from previous GSC export; real-time automatic continuous sync requires service account key in environment.
